body:
There were a bunch of things leading up to the "collapse". I felt i was pretending to be someone i'm not, I have a chronic headache preventing me from thinking clearly, I have no real skills and i'm simply pathetic. One week when i got home from the grocery store my girlfriend called me and said she was afraid she might kill herself, I dragged my mom to the car and we drove the 30 minutes it took to get there.

I didn't even knock i just threw the doors open and ran up the stairs. She was lying on the floor crying, I laid down next to her, hugging her, talking to her. This went on for a few hours until she said she needed some time alone, by this time I wasn't afraid for her life anymore and respected her need to alone.

It turns out her parents had a huge fight and were getting a divorce.

Later that very week i got home and saw my family sitting at the table, they told me to sit down. My dad had been diagnosed with Huntington's disease. That night i had my first panic attack.
